basic_info.description:
Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom home nestled in the desirable Sunset District.  Spanning 1,525 square feet, this residence offers a cozy yet spacious environment perfect for comfortable living. The heart of the home is the living and dining rooms, with refinished parquet floors and fresh paint.  Ideally situated near excellent schools, Golden Gate Park, Stonestown Galleria and restaurants.  Shopping a short distance away on Irving, Noreiga, and Taraval streets.  A full garage offers expansion opportunities.  Recreation room down.  Easy access to Muni.  Large backyard is perfect for gardening and playing children.

The property includes a spacious 2-car garage, providing ample storage and convenience. Laundry facilities are conveniently located within the home, adding to the ease of daily living. Situated on a 2,996-square-foot lot, this property offers both indoor and outdoor space for your enjoyment. 

The home is located within the San Francisco Unified School District. Don't miss the opportunity to make this delightful San Francisco home your own.
